$comment: Four entries of vendor/vuln-triage.json as first written, one for each id in osv.json, for tests/unit/vuln-watch.test.ts.

entries.reason: The engine downloads every feed over HTTPS through requests and urllib3 on this ssl module, verifying against certifi's bundle, which carries an eMudhra root (emSign Root CA - G1 is still in certifi 2026.10.23, newer than the pinned 2026.10.19), so without the denylist 3.12.14 would accept a forged certificate under the compromised eMudhra intermediates. CPython 3.12.16 carries the fix, in python-build-standalone 20261026, so it needs a pin move.

The same issue as CVE-2026-115557, under the PSF's id. The engine downloads every feed over HTTPS on this ssl module, which lacks the denylist in 3.12.14, so it is open with that entry's due date; CPython 3.12.16 carries the fix.
The loop is in the DASH demuxer, which the pinned build does not compile: its demuxers are image2, mov and gif alone (ADR-040).

The overflow is in gz_write, after a failed write through gzwrite. Nothing that carries zlib 1.3.2 writes through the gz* file API: CPython on Windows compiles none of zlib's gz*.c files (PCbuild/pythoncore.vcxproj at v3.12.14), FFmpeg calls only deflate, inflate and uncompress, and LOOM only gzread (util::zreadAll at the pinned commit; the macOS builds of both import nothing else from libz).
